verdict.rationale: The building blocks are evidenced: an official MCP server (salesforcecli/mcp) and Salesforce APIs give programmatic access, AI syncs emails and events into the CRM, and Agentforce shows an "Updating opportunity" agent use case across deal stages. Nothing documents an agent that actually turns email or meeting signals into stage and next-step updates through the API or MCP server, so the end-to-end flow has to be assembled and is only implied. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for writing opportunity stage and next-step fields, evidence linking email/meeting signals to automated stage updates, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
